dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: Miss Aino's upgrades truly work wonders. Next time, I should test it out on tougher opponents.

dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: It's just marvelous... I designed a right piece of junk, but Miss Aino turned it into something truly formidable, just like that. Now, if we'd started with a machine designed by her instead...

dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: What would happen if her skills caught the eyes of some villains?
